duplication_audit.distinction: v20 and forcing analogs use wind-speed-squared, gust excess, direction alignment and pressure tendency as separate inputs. v76 uniquely combines observed pressure, air temperature and relative humidity into moist-air density before weighting sustained/gust squared speeds; it contains no KMA adjustment, direction alignment, forecast output, spectrum, pole, codifference or causal-dependence estimator.
duplication_audit.novel_axis: past-only moist-air-density-weighted sustained and gust wind momentum-flux proxies
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: official feedback is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection
duplication_audit.repository_negative_fingerprint: No executed P3 air-density, moist-air equation-of-state, rho-U-squared, density-weighted gust momentum, or thermodynamic wind-momentum feature contract was found.

primary_sources.citation: Picard, Davis, Glaser, and Fujii, Revised formula for the density of moist air (CIPM-2007), Metrologia 45, 149-155 (2008)
primary_sources.use: moist-air density motivation only; simplified fixed partial-density calculation is preregistered here
